purpose: Propose a one-time offline submission transport for a future external runtime without exposing the canonical persistent output to the implementation identity. This draft does not alter the current ordinal-3 candidate, schema, or any runtime authority.
requiredInvariants: The submission VHDX is created only after the nonce and is neither an OS disk, a checkpoint disk, a saved-state disk, nor a reusable data disk.
The implementation identity cannot list, mount, raw-read, raw-write, rename, delete, or resolve the submission volume. It can write only the fixed archive in ephemeral work scratch.

A byte-pinned guest supervisor distinct from the implementation identity may copy only /p3/scratch/work/return.ustar.tar to the predeclared submission pathname, and only after all implementation processes have terminated.
Before offline extraction, the host verifier proves role termination, VM Off state, no saved state, no checkpoint, exact detach, no writer handle, expected VHD chain, and a nonce-bound VHDX hash.

The extractor is a separate identity and isolated parser environment. It mounts no untrusted submission filesystem on the main coordinator host and accepts no role-authored pathname, option, destination, or configuration.

The extractor may emit only the fixed submission archive into a private spool. The fixed exporter may create only the canonical fixed archive pathname after separate validation and no-replace atomic creation.
The VHDX child is never reused. Success requires a disposal receipt; failure cannot create canonical output and requires host-only forensic retention or disposal under separate authority.
No guest evidence collection claim, default-deny model egress claim, typed evidence validation claim, or P-11 claim is supplied by this amendment.
knownUnresolvedBlockers: Current native Hyper-V has no approved host-only collector for guest evidence without retaining a host-control channel.
A model-endpoint-only default-deny egress topology is unselected.
The current proof schema and pair-common protocol do not support this submission transport.
An isolated parser/extractor, typed validator, and independent audit are unimplemented.
Retention, backup, antivirus, encryption, and disposal evidence for raw submission bytes are unselected.
ownerReviewRequired: Accept or reject this separate submission-transport semantics without treating it as scratch replacement.
Select and independently audit an isolated readonly extractor and fixed guest supervisor.
Approve a successor pair-common protocol and typed validator only after exact final bytes are available.
Authorize any P-3-free synthetic VM probe separately.
